# Official MAX icon-only marks

Source and usage guidance: https://go.max.ru/brandbook (accessed 2026-09-28). The brandbook offers separate logo versions with and without text and asks users to preserve proportions and keep the mark clear against its background. Its linked detailed Figma rules were not accessible from this environment. No open-source licence is asserted.

| Project asset | Official download | Original member | SHA-256 of member | SHA-256 of ZIP |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `max-colored.svg` | https://st.max.ru/brandbook/max-colored.zip | `Max colored.svg` | `5CAA61A4B0731D0D89421B4FB24F41433025E5AEA59155A14CF3A3FADA6C9174` | `BFB540772C667BA12A2E9052295CD91DAD39EBD8D270038262F2F2404303C206` |
| `max-white.svg` | https://st.max.ru/brandbook/max-white.zip | `Max white.svg` | `2D4939E3CF89A5EB61114D8EFAC7B9F67B03737F1226853F177D931E3B354DBD` | `6FAFFBA487E25DCCC29421EE162624ACC8F8E12BD9C33C71A2BA6CBEDE46D7B8` |

Both SVG members are copied byte-for-byte. No paths, colors or proportions were changed. The colored mark appears with a text label on light secondary MAX actions; the white mark appears with a text label on the existing red primary MAX actions. These are visual assets only; native MAX sharing remains a separate integration.
